description: Ubuntu 22.04 OpenSSL FIPS provider implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: SSH KDF using CPACF SHA implementation.

details: Linux distribution developed by Canonical Ltd. and targeted toward the commercial market.
Processor z15(TM) (processor family S390) from IBM

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
